scope: RBMOBJ1 exact124B catalog-bound header, HKDF/AES256GCM authenticated32KiB frames, streaming PREPARED packed bytes; not compression/HTML/mail DB/key custody/source admission
metadata: native trusted catalog/preparation supplies epoch/account/purpose/keyversion, original/packed lengths, digest and admitted maxima; decrypt compares exact full expected header BEFORE releasing any payload; never construct expected metadata by trusting received header
freshness: seal accepts only fresh CSPRNG128 object-ID WritePlan. Atomic one-use consumption even on error/cancel; no encrypt-existing-descriptor API. Catalog still must reserve uniqueness; RNG uniqueness is probabilistic, not a verified global registry. Retry/recompression uses a NEW plan/ID; dedup reuses existing immutable bytes, never reencrypts.
bounds: metadata lengths validated against native Limits and frameCountU32 capacity before crypto; no allocation by declared object length. At most32768 plaintext/32784 cipher bytes per frame. long counters/checked representable framed length, one authenticated empty frame.
streamContract: InputStream/OutputStream are native owned finite local staging, not arbitrary remote/user paths. Helpers do not close, flush, fsync or publish caller streams. Reads returning0 use bounded single-byte fallback; cancellation checked around frame/read boundaries, blocking IO still needs real owner settlement.
authentication: per-frame doFinal tag succeeds BEFORE emitting that decrypted frame to private UNPUBLISHED staging. Prefix emitted before a later failure remains TAINTED and must be abandoned. No whole-object success until exact frames/EOF and RAW digest validated.
codecBoundary: RAW requires originalLength==packedLength and streaming original digest check. ZLIB outputs authenticated packed bytes only: caller MailObjectCodec MUST bounded-inflate and validate original length/digest before successful read/export/publication.
keys: caller supplies32B account/purpose/version DEK from trusted vault; copied arrays best-effort zeroed after use, derived key/PRK too. JCA provider internal copies not claimed erased. No formal/real keys generated by helper.
keyDerivation: exact R9 HKDF-SHA256 single32B block; epoch salt, KEY domain/account/object/purpose/version info; nonce8zero+indexU32; AAD domain/full header/index/plain length
failures: bad header/scope/length/EOF/digest -> generic IOException; AEAD/provider -> GeneralSecurityException; cancelled -> InterruptedIOException. No fallback plaintext, automatic retry, account deletion or DB mutation.
requiredTests: old prototype encode -> production streaming decrypt and reverse, RAW/ZLIB
full-header/tag/scope/key tamper and malformed lengths rejected
one-shot even failed/cancelled plan, fresh-ID copies
verified prefix remains private staging on late failure
cooperative cancellation is not blocked-IO termination
native limits enforce lengths, no close/publish by helper
integrationGate: source/epoch/account key selection, unique-object catalog, private stage abort/erasure manifest, codec verification and atomic refs/cursor/current-fence commit remain native owner responsibilities
